record.question: The nephew is _________ than his uncle.
record.explanation: Answer C: older. Older is the comparative form used with than (C); elder is generally attributive and does not normally take than. Independent check: “Older than” is the ordinary comparative for age. “Elder” generally does not take “than” in this construction. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/elder-eldest-or-older-oldest. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
